qualification_scope.database: Real disposable primary PostgreSQL and physically separate encrypted signed write-intent journal PostgreSQL; forced RLS and non-owner runtime roles.
qualification_scope.wordpress: Loopback stdlib Core REST contract double behind actual shared-egress admission; no public test service and no live WordPress or provider TLS claim.
qualification_scope.openbao: Real locally trusted OpenBao TLS, single-binding read-only ACL, forbidden write/delete/sibling read, missing-secret denial and tenant/site/origin assignment before provider I/O.
qualification_scope.ambiguity: Truncated responses, delayed commit after zero-match read, multiple matches, post-insert rejection, confirmed admission deferral, definitive pre-write rejection and per-attempt rollback/crash replay.
qualification_scope.authority: Exact owner approval; tenant, role, session, recovery, origin generation, membership/site epoch, facts, superseded brief, pause and binding revocation negatives; no standing dispatch.
qualification_scope.public_verification: Actual 0085 GET gateway with sealed content plus pure visible/hidden/injected/noindex HTML tests; not browser/theme certification.

development_corrections: Stopped the invocation-owned first delivery run for a long-line formatting correction; that interrupted run is not qualification. Restarted with frozen backend/test source.

Final security review added operator-provisioned OpenBao tenant/site/origin assignment checked against server-derived owner scope before initial binding or delivery I/O. Stopped only the invocation-owned delivery run; restarted qualification against the corrected source. Added three PostgreSQL/real-reader rejection cases and a real OpenBao assignment check.

Owner permalink edits now record edited_before_publish through the recorded-id read rather than disappearing behind marker matching. Marker reconciliation stays exact. The original content-edit case remains, with an additional permalink-edit case; final backend source frozen and full gate restarted.

A full delivery run passed 53 cases and failed 18 WordPress cases because pytest collected the prior module under a different name, generating a second test journal key. Strict journal verification correctly denied the mismatched signatures. Moved only ephemeral test signing/encryption material into the existing shared support module; all assertions and cryptographic checks remain. Added an alternate-module-loading regression test and reran the full delivery gate.
First page-attempt setup had a transient Docker command failure; unchanged retry passed with owned cleanup.

First candidate-sandbox run passed all ten tests but global cleanup detection saw another track's active candidate container; no foreign container was stopped. Unchanged retry passed and confirmed cleanup.
Stale or revoked bindings retain an owner revocation control before reconnecting; dashboard regression gate rerun.

The new stale-binding dashboard test initially used an unconfigured-provider fixture, which correctly showed provider unavailability instead. Corrected that synthetic fixture to configured-with-stale-binding; all original assertions retained and full npm gate passed.
An optional whole-directory scan included ignored runtime/generated artifacts and is not commit-range evidence. Explicit staged diff scan passed; main allowlist unchanged.
